operation: Read-only scalar extraction from existing archived result.json files; no simulation/replay and no model or raw log transfer.

definitions.decisions: Post-warm-up intersection-by-decision-epoch choices, excluding the 60-s warm-up.
definitions.collision_events: Sum of len(simulation.getCollisions()) over simulation steps: raw collision records, not a count of colliding vehicles. A continuing contact can contribute repeated records.
definitions.collision_event_steps: Number of simulation steps with at least one collision record.
definitions.collision_incidents: Within-run distinct (sorted collider/victim IDs, collision type, lane) keys.
definitions.effective_overrides: Executor-accepted non-reference switch requests plus effective holds of current green. An accepted request is not a completed green-phase change.
definitions.guard_rejections: All rejected_* counters except rejected_cooldown, rejected_coordination, and rejected_executor.
definitions.accepted_trace: Coordinator-approved proposals; may include ineffective requests and is capped at 256 per run. Rates use complete guard counters, not trace lengths.
definitions.pressure_policies: PP and MP have no learned guard audit; empty guard fields mean not applicable, not zero.
definitions.accounting: decisions = prior_agreements + guard_rejections + proposed_overrides; proposed_overrides = effective_overrides + rejected_cooldown + rejected_coordination + rejected_executor.
